subject: SIG: service-account & SCIM delta artifacts for CareNova
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@carenova.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@carenova.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: service-account & SCIM delta artifacts for CareNova

Sean / Redwood team,

Thanks for the call earlier. As part of our SIG intake for the integration we need an access control artifact pack focusing on service accounts and provisioning. Specifically we need:

- A redacted roster of all service accounts with owner and purpose (CSV or PDF).
- A SCIM delta sample (one week window) showing creations, updates, and deletes — prefer CSV with header + 100-200 rows.
- SAML assertion example(s) for a typical user login (timestamped).
- Mapping of RBAC roles to least-privilege owners (spreadsheet OK).

Target for intake is next Friday (Aug 29). Please confirm what you can provide and any redaction rules you apply. We will treat anything marked confidential per our DPA.

Also looping procurement in case we need an updated DocuSign for the amended Addendum (we're finishing legal).

Thanks,
Alice Moreno
Senior Security Analyst, CareNova
alice.moreno@carenova.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@carenova.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: service-account & SCIM delta artifacts for CareNova

On Thu, Aug 21, 2025 at 9:12 AM Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@carenova.com> wrote:
> Sean / Redwood team,
> 
> Thanks for the call earlier. As part of our SIG intake for the integration we need an access control artifact pack focusing on service accounts and provisioning.

Hi Alice — appreciate the clear checklist. We can provide the items you listed; here's our proposed delivery plan:

1) Today: confirm scope and share a small sample SCIM CSV (sanitized) and a sample SAML assertion.
2) By Tue (Aug 26): full SCIM delta slice (CSV), role-to-owner mapping (XLSX), and redacted service account roster (PDF).
3) By Fri (Aug 29): complete bundle including a short readme describing redaction rules and time window.

Attachments we'll include in the first drop: carenova_scim_delta_sample.csv (header + 50 rows), service_account_roster_redacted.pdf, sig_control_map.xlsx. If you need the SCIM sample in JSON instead of CSV we can do that — let us know.

HubSpot deal: DN-44321 (I added the SIG intake as an action item). Also sending a DocuSign link for the amendment separately so procurement can sign.

Would you prefer the service account roster to include last-used timestamps? We can add that column but it will require an extra pull (2 business days).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0143

Attachments: carenova_scim_delta_sample.csv (stub), service_account_roster_redacted.pdf (stub), sig_control_map.xlsx (stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@carenova.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: service-account & SCIM delta artifacts for CareNova

Thanks — quick follow up from the engineering side.

We attached a sanitized SCIM delta sample (carenova_scim_delta_sample.csv) that includes the column headers we typically export: operation,timestamp,user_id,external_id,displayName,emails,groups,source

Notes on redaction: we replaced any PII in displayName/emails with deterministic hashes (sha256 truncated) and removed IP addresses. The service_account_roster_redacted.pdf contains owner contact and purpose but omits internal ticket ids. The sig_control_map.xlsx maps RBAC role names to owners and lists the minimal permissions associated with each role.

If you need last-used timestamps for service accounts we can include a "last_auth" column; it'll add ~48 hours to the pull because we need to aggregate from audit logs. Happy to do that if it's useful for your risk assessment.

Also: what date range do you want for the SAML assertion examples? We can pull two assertions from the last 30 days (one success, one expired token) if that helps.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: carenova_scim_delta_sample.csv, service_account_roster_redacted.pdf, sig_control_map.xlsx

From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@carenova.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@carenova.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: service-account & SCIM delta artifacts for CareNova

Camila / Sean —

Received, thanks for the fast turn. The SCIM sample looks good; the headers are exactly what we expected. For the SAML assertions please include two from the last 30 days as you suggested (one successful login, one expired assertion).

We do want the last-used timestamps for service accounts — that will help our internal owners verify orphaned accounts. If adding last_auth pushes the delivery to Aug 28, that's fine.

Procurement: we confirmed the DocuSign amendment link — procurement team, please ping if you need a copy of the SIG control mapping for contracting.

I'll plan a 20-minute sync on Thursday Aug 28 to walk through the artifacts; can you both confirm availability?

Thanks,
Alice Moreno
Senior Security Analyst, CareNova
